audit_item: A10 / compute lease and resource recovery JSON integrity
finding: Compute lease ownership, Windows recovery enrollment/evidence, GPU owner lock state, and durable recovery receipts were read with the default JSON decoder. Duplicate keys could make ambiguous ownership facts appear acceptable or affect recovery inspection.
change: Added recursive strict JSON parsing for persisted compute runtime state. GPU acquire/release normalize corrupted metadata to ComputeError without dropping the lock; enrollment/recovery evidence readers fail closed; quota inspection rejects ambiguous durable receipts.
